doc: An SLO of openslo.com/v2alpha, the version OpenSLO is drafting, stands in a v1 stream: it is not drawn, listed as Unbound with openslo.version, a warning, and kept exactly as written (research R7). Its indicatorRef names an SLI no document is, and no missing-reference is reported for it, since a document that is not drawn makes no reference. The findings are the definition's (openslo-slo.dis, constraints), stated with their element and severity for a host to replay; FBL itself reports nothing on this stream, and the validator's reading check compares the elements.
